title: Kibbeh Labanieh
description: Traditional kibbeh cooked in creamy yogurt sauce - a Lebanese favorite.
steps: Soak bulgur in water for 10 minutes, then drain well.
Mix ground meat, bulgur, half the onion, salt, pepper, and allspice. Knead well.
Shape mixture into small oval balls.
Whisk yogurt with cornstarch until smooth.
Bring yogurt mixture to a boil, stirring constantly.
Add kibbeh balls and simmer for 20 minutes.
In a pan, sauté garlic, remaining onion, and mint in butter.
Pour garlic mixture over kibbeh and serve with rice.

title: Fattoush Salad
description: Fresh Middle Eastern salad with crispy pita chips and sumac dressing.
steps: Toast pita bread until crispy, then break into bite-sized pieces.
Combine all vegetables and herbs in a large bowl.
Whisk together lemon juice, olive oil, sumac, and salt.
Add pita chips just before serving.
Toss with dressing and serve immediately.
